title: abrahamaiproject-bit/atlas-api-gateway
body:
# atlas-api-gateway

Public REST gateway for **Project Atlas**. It handles auth, rate limiting, and request routing to the routing engine.

## Endpoints
| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | `/v1/routes/optimize` | Submit stops and get optimized routes |
| GET | `/v1/routes/{id}` | Fetch a computed route |
| GET | `/healthz` | Health check |

## Performance target
p95 latency under 250ms (currently 310ms; see the benchmarks from Joe Smith).
